notes:
Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.44

- Fixed normal NPC population recovery across all 24 maps, including Jack RedSails on Map 1/1.
- Normal NPC replacements now preserve the defeated NPC type, respect the configured population cap, and return after a seven-second server-authoritative delay.
- Kept World Boss thresholds, rewards, combat balance, and kill-credit behavior unchanged while hardening rapid multi-kill respawns.
- Added server-authoritative game-version admission so beta.44 servers request the current beta.44 client through the Launcher.
- Reduced the Guild creation price from 50,000 Gold to 1,000 Gold.
- Rebalanced cannon prices to 2× and cannonball pack prices to 4× their previous values.
- Purchases remain disabled for this Beta release.
